name: Storage Vessel
description: Stores process liquid before it moves to the next stage.

name: Process Compressor
description: Compresses process gas to increase its pressure.

name: Electric Motor
description: Provides mechanical power to the connected equipment.

name: Pressure Control Valve
description: Regulates process pressure by controlling fluid flow.

name: Flow Transmitter
description: Measures and transmits process fluid flow measurements.

name: Heat Exchanger
description: Transfers thermal energy between process fluids.

name: Process Reactor
description: Provides a vessel for carrying out chemical reactions.

name: Pressure Safety Valve
description: Provides overpressure protection by releasing pressure under designed conditions.

name: Temperature Control Valve
description: Regulates temperature by controlling process flow.

name: Process Pump A
description: Transfers process fluid through the plant.

name: Process Pump B
description: Provides an additional or standby pumping unit.

name: Storage Tank
description: Stores processed liquid for further use or distribution.
